live A2A/RMN call to env OCCUPATION_ENTROPY_AGENT_URL

reasonsNotFoldable: This one seller's live transport (src/server.mjs) serves a mix of routes: four are already pure functions callable by package+export (issuer-evidence, aggressive-alpha, paper-intent, reconcile, report-graphics/render), but three more (divination/daily-reading, occupation-entropy, strategies/synthesize) each dispatch a live network call to an agent URL read from env at request time - the market's compute binding has no way to inject those live endpoints, and no way to express 'this offer needs a per-deployment agent URL, not just a pure function of the request'.

src/server.mjs additionally does its own facilitator selection (selectedFacilitator, reading CDP_API_KEY_ID/CDP_API_KEY_SECRET and env.X402_FACILITATOR_PROVIDER) and its own durable settlement-witness journal (settlement-witness.mjs, requiring env.BROKERAGE_X402_DATA_ROOT) - both would need to be superseded by the market's own facilitatorClientFactory and settlementWitness/createSettlementJournal before this boundary could be deleted, which is only safe to do for all eight routes at once (deleting server.mjs while three routes still need it would remove their only transport).

The tree is under active, unrelated concurrent editing at the time of this survey: `git status` showed uncommitted changes to src/server.mjs, src/http-border.mjs, and multiple sibling packages under alpaca-services-section/services/ (issuer-research-media-service, principal-brokerage-interface, strategy-program-candidate-assay-service, union-brokerage-products-market-border, virtuals-brokerage-products-border, metered-compute-payment-service, alpaca-paper-account-read-service, alpaca-principal-account-read-service) that this fold did not make. Ripping out this seller's transport mid-edit by someone else risks losing work that is not this task's to resolve.

The consuming app's own test (ALP/test/x402-server.test.mjs) asserts a 'blkStrategy' product at $3.00 that does not exist in the currently committed src/server.mjs ROUTES table - the test is already stale/broken independent of this fold, a further sign this package is mid-refactor rather than a stable target to migrate right now.

coinbase-x402-bazaar-border's own package.json already depends on @red-cup-engineering/x402-services-section at 0.4.0, so a future migration does not need a fresh dependency pin, only the market catalog work and the live-effect question above.
whatTheMarketEngineWouldNeed: Either: a way to fold only a subset of one seller's routes into the catalog while the remaining routes keep their own transport (i.e. partial-seller migration, not all-or-nothing) - the market currently assumes one seller's transport is deleted entirely once any of its offers are catalog entries.

Or: a compute-binding extension that can name a live delegate (an agent-card URL, resolved per-deployment via env or a market-level rails object analogous to facilitatorClientFactory) for the three routes that call out to divination/occupation-entropy/strategy-synthesis agents, so those could fold too once the pure routes do.
A resolution of the in-flight uncommitted edits in this tree before any transport deletion is attempted, so this fold does not collide with concurrent work.
actionTaken: None. src/server.mjs, src/http-border.mjs, src/market-runtime.mjs (alpaca-services-section), and settlement-witness.mjs were left untouched. No catalog entry was added, no dependency was pinned, and no transport file was deleted.
verifiedBy: Read-only research (see repo history) plus `git status` on the alpaca-services-section tree; no code in this package was executed or modified.

resolution.how: All eight routes are catalog entries under gateway brokerage-control. The four pure ones (issuer-evidence, aggressive-alpha, paper-intent, report-graphic-render) bind directly to their true owning packages (issuer-research-media-service, alpha-portfolio-order-intent-service, deterministic-report-graphic-service), never through coinbase-x402-bazaar-border; account-reconciliation binds to one small pure composition, reconcileAccountEvidence(body), added to coinbase-x402-bazaar-border because no single upstream export matched this seller's historical {expected, observed} contract. The three agentic ones (daily-divination-reading, occupation-entropy, strategy-synthesis) are exported as (body, env) operations from the same package's new src/brokerage-control-operations.mjs, each a thin adapter over the existing provider factories in src/product-providers.mjs and src/strategy-synthesis-provider.mjs (their live agent URLs -- DIVINATION_BASE_URL, OCCUPATION_ENTROPY_AGENT_URL, INFERENCE_WORK_LOT_AGENT_CARD_URL -- are env, not reasons); the ratchet that made an unresolvable optional capability read as a 500 rather than a validate-style 422 was product-providers.mjs's own unavailable() helper throwing a plain Error instead of a TypeError, fixed alongside. src/server.mjs, src/http-border.mjs, and src/settlement-witness.mjs (this seller's own transport, facilitator selection, and settlement witness) are deleted, together with the coinbase-x402-bazaar-border tests that existed only to exercise them (test/server.test.mjs, test/border-authority.test.mjs, test/strategy-x402-receiver.test.mjs) and the alpaca-services-section-level test that imported server.mjs directly (test/x402-server.test.mjs, deleted) plus the one test in test/operational-services.test.mjs that exercised http-border.mjs directly (removed, with a comment pointing to its replacement coverage). alpaca-services-section/src/market-runtime.mjs does more than the x402 seller loop -- it also composes alpacaRead (principal-authenticated venue read), execution-transport (principal-authenticated venue write), and the BLK accumulation strategy provider, none of which are anonymous pay-per-call catalog candidates (they act on one already-authorized customer account) -- so it was kept, with only its x402-selling composition (createBrokerageMarketRuntime, its createBrokerageX402Server import, and its CLI runner) removed; createBrokerageProductProviders/indexBrokerageProvidersByService, which union-runtime.mjs and virtuals-runtime.mjs depend on for their own non-x402 (ActivityPub/Virtuals) distribution of the same four pure products, are unchanged. union-runtime.mjs and virtuals-runtime.mjs needed no edits: they never imported server.mjs, http-border.mjs, or settlement-witness.mjs, only market-runtime.mjs's compute-composing exports, which still exist with the same shape. The stale-blkStrategy-test concern this finding raised had already been resolved by a concurrent session before this fold; verified by re-running alpaca-services-section/test/x402-server.test.mjs (now deleted) at 4/4 green before deleting it.
